frame_layout.proof: Decoded constant SUB ESP in the straight-line entry prefix; no branches/calls crossed.
frame_layout.limit: Local widths are unique-name DWARF evidence, not complete frame accounting. Spill slots, outgoing call arguments, alignment and lifetime reuse also affect allocation. This never proves body or layout-only equality.

signedness.limit: DWARF variable types and function instruction counts; variable-to-instruction attribution requires location evidence. Char encoding is available through type DIE.

branch_context.limit: Each side is decoded independently. Equal offsets do not identify corresponding blocks; outside-function targets and indirect transfers are not resolved here. No source cause, CFG equivalence or layout proof is inferred.

instruction_alignment.normalization: Candidate absolute fields use independent resolved values; external transfers use independent targets; intra-function transfers use decoded instruction indices. Unresolved fields never align with original bytes.
instruction_alignment.limit: Sequence alignment is heuristic and may be ambiguous in repeated code. Equal groups are not body/semantic/layout proof. Never changes status, routing, edit permission or promotion.

emission_order.note: Emission-order context differs from history (candidate predecessor show_instructions versus historical load_new_ad_image); part of the mismatch may be a neighbor artifact.

known_rules.symptom: Instruction skeletons match, but aligned pointer operands reference different literal payloads.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Wrong filename format, file mode, default string, or formatting spaces can masquerade as relocation layout differences.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Use repair_literal_content when the card identifies unique explicit source tokens. It changes only those tokens. Equal content with unknown ownership stays blocked; original operand content is diagnostic evidence, not an independent relocation binding.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Fresh strict comparison, independently resolved relocations, neighbor preservation, ordinary link regression check and atomic publication.

applicability.limit: Symptom filtering narrows hypotheses; it does not prove the source cause or authorize a repair. Historical example membership alone is not current applicability.

routing_evidence.limit: Explains the base heuristic only. Recorded blocks, interface/owner prerequisites and proved bounded recipes take precedence; difficulty is the final routing decision.

callee_interface_scope.limit: Known direct-callee conflicts only. Verified call addresses do not prove declaration/type compatibility. Remote-only conflicts remain visible but do not block a proven local interface; unknown indirect targets are not inferred.
